instructions: Read old_text vs new_text for each entry and fill in should_approve, error_kind, reason, confirmed_by and confirmed_at. The proposed_* fields are intent-derived starting points and may be wrong -- that is why this file exists. Entries left unconfirmed are excluded from the study.

confirmations.old_text: The Vendor shall design, build and deliver a freight utilisation reporting platform for the Client's UK depot network. It is acknowledged and agreed by and between the parties hereto that the platform shall ingest telematics data from the Client's existing fleet management system and shall produce daily utilisation reporting at depot, region and national level.
confirmations.new_text: The Vendor shall design, build and deliver a freight utilisation reporting platform for the Client's UK depot network. The parties agree that the platform shall ingest telematics data from the Client's existing fleet management system and shall produce daily utilisation reporting at depot, region and national level.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Removes legalese padding. No obligation is altered.

confirmations.old_text: Each deliverable shall be deemed accepted when the Client confirms in writing that it meets the acceptance criteria in Schedule 1, or fifteen (15) business days after delivery if the Client has raised no written objection.
confirmations.new_text: Each deliverable shall be deemed accepted if the Client provides written confirmation of acceptance or if the Client raises no written objection within fifteen (15) business days after delivery.

confirmations.old_text: Work shall commence on 6 April 2026. The Vendor shall deliver the ingestion pipeline by 29 May 2026, the reporting dashboard by 10 July 2026, and shall complete handover and training by 07/08/2026.

confirmations.proposed_reason: Removes a real DD/MM versus MM/DD ambiguity by restating the same date unambiguously. The date itself does not move.

confirmations.old_text: The total fixed price for the Services described in this Statement of Work is one hundred and eighty thousand pounds (£180,000), exclusive of VAT.
